description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM œKeyed Alike Lock Set consisting of the Ignition, Drivers Door Lock, Passengers Door Lock and the Glovebox Door Lock.
Includes the Lock Cylinder Attachment Clips
Includes the Latch Rod Attachment Clips
Comes with 2 OEM “Suzuki” Keys
Includes a metal Key Code Plate.
Note: The ignition switch has an OEM Connector that is plug & play. The Accessory door wire is not included. (That means if you have the key in the ignition and you open the drivers door, the buzzer will not sound. This is especially convenient if you take off your doors from time to time)
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Ignition Switch
Qty 1 – Door Lock Cylinder – Driver’s Side
Qty 1 – Door Lock Cylinder – Passenger’s Side
Qty 1 – Door Lock Cylinder – Glove Box
Qty 2 – Keys – “Suzuki”
Qty 1 – Key Code Plate
Qty 2 – Attachment Clips – Latch Rod
Qty 2 – Attachment Clips – Lock Cylinder
Qty 2 – Attachment Bolts – Ignition Switch
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1992 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1992 All Models
